brief:
Palestinians in Gaza are recycling debris from destroyed homes to reconstruct their dwellings, the Ma'an news agency reported. Residents salvage concrete, metal, and other materials from collapsed structures to use in rebuilding efforts amid ongoing devastation and severe shortages of construction supplies.

The practice reflects the scale of destruction across Gaza and the limited access to new building materials as Palestinians attempt to restore shelter for their families.
title: Palestinians rebuild homes from rubble of destroyed buildings
